name: Collection hero
description: The top of a category page: breadcrumb, collection title, item count and a short intro, over a tinted band.

name: Product grid
description: The catalogue body: a 4-up grid of product cards that drops to 2-up on a tablet and 1-up on a phone.

name: Product card states
description: The four states one card has to cover: default, on sale with a strike-through RRP, sold out, and low stock. T260 on pages/commerce.html is the original single product card.

name: Product list row
description: The horizontal alternative to a card, for list-view toggles and search results: thumb left, details centre, price and CTA right.

name: Sort and result bar
description: The strip above the grid: how many results, how they are ordered, and whether they show as cards or rows.

name: Filter rail
description: The desktop faceted sidebar: collapsible groups, checkbox facets with counts, swatch chips, a price pair and a clear-all.

name: Filter drawer
description: The phone equivalent of the rail, on a native dialog: a trigger with a count, a slide-in panel, then apply or clear.

name: Active filter chips
description: What is currently narrowing the results, each one removable on its own, with a clear-all beside them.

name: Quick view modal
description: Buy from the grid without leaving it: a dialog with the image, price, variants, quantity and add-to-cart, opened from a card overlay button.

name: Load more and pagination
description: Both ways to get to page two: a load-more button with a progress line, and a numbered pagination row for crawlable pages.

name: Empty results state
description: What the grid says when the facets return nothing: name the cause, offer the filters worth dropping, and keep a way out.

name: Category tiles
description: The shop landing grid: one tile per collection on a wash background, with a label and an item count.
